messages:
maria: Quick ping — I'm blocked on a cross-repo merge. SDK PR #1243 merged on my side but console integration tests are failing because the API change in api-service requires the new `x-source` header. I didn't realize console was still using the old client. Can someone from backend/console help coordinate the change and timing? cc @lee @alex

lee: Saw the failure in CI earlier. Looking into it now. Do we have a simple backward-compatible fallback we can ship to avoid a staged break?

maria: There's a tiny shim we can add to SDK to keep honoring missing header for a week. Patch is small: adds header fallback in `client.request()` — if `x-source` missing, default to `console`. But I'd rather not keep it long-term.

alex: If we can get the shim in SDK and a minor bump in console before API rollout, we can schedule a coordinated deploy. Timeline?

maria: I can put up SDK PR with shim in ~1h. Console needs a minor change to set the header in the fetch wrapper. That looks like 2 dev-hours max. API team planning to promote the change tomorrow at 18:00 UTC.

sam: Is there any helm/runtime rollout concern? The API rollout touches ingress rules for header-based routing. If we flip routing before console sets header, requests could be misrouted. @ci-bot can you confirm which clusters are on the new routing?

ci-bot: build:api-service/main -> promoted to staging-3, canary-prod-2. No global flip scheduled.

lee: Thanks @ci-bot. That means we can do canary first. Proposed plan: 1) maria posts SDK shim PR now, 2) alex or console owner merges console header set, 3) API team does canary routing change, monitor 15m, then global if OK.

maria: PR is up: github.com/redwood/sdk/pull/1251 — includes tests.

alex: I'll open console PR and add you as reviewer, @maria. Will aim to merge within 2h.

maria: Great. Once console PR merged, can someone add a short note to the rollout channel so ops can watch canary? Something like: "canary routing enable for api-service at 18:00 UTC (watch 15m) — rollback if 5xx rate > 0.5%"

lee: I'll post that and get ops eyes on it. Also we should add a short compatibility note to the release docs explaining shim is temporary and expected removal in ~7 days after rollout.

sam: Quick check — does the shim require a new image for dedicated? If so we need to stage the image push.

maria: It does require SDK client image bump (patch). I'll include image tag in PR description and trigger a build on merge.

ci-bot: ci: sdk#1251 -> build queued.

alex: pinging console oncall to review after lunch.

maria: Thanks all. I'll link back here when PR is green and merged.

lee: Thanks — looks like a smooth path. I'll coordinate the canary watch and post the ops note before API env flip. :thumbsup:

maria: Updated: sdk#1251 passed CI and merged (sha: 9f2c3b). Console PR at github.com/redwood/console/pull/342 needs one approval from @alex.

alex: Approved and merged. Console image build started.

ci-bot: deploy:console -> image pushed: console:v1.12.3-patch

lee: Ops note posted to #rollouts: "canary routing enable for api-service at 18:00 UTC (watch 15m) — rollback if 5xx rate > 0.5%". Monitoring alert pinned.

maria: API team scheduled the canary flip at 18:05 UTC. I'll stay by for 30m to watch integration tests in staging.

sam: If anything weird shows up I'll be on standby for quick rollback.

maria: Canary complete, no errors observed. API global flip proceeding. Thanks everyone for quick turnaround.

lee: Nice work. Follow-up: add a tech-note in the SDK repo about the shim removal and set an issue to delete it after 7 days.

maria: Will do. Closing this thread — will open a postmortem if any regressions crop up. :white_check_mark:
